## Vertical slice checklist

- [ ] Migration (if any) reviewed by a human, generated by Drizzle
- [ ] `can()` covers new actions; no ad-hoc role checks
- [ ] Audit interceptor covers new mutations / sensitive reads
- [ ] Integration test per new tRPC procedure (response + DB + audit)
- [ ] Tenant-isolation registry extended for new tables and procedures
- [ ] UI strings in `i18n/sk.ts`, no Slovak in code
- [ ] No health data in logs / Sentry / analytics / push payloads

## `senior-review` only

- [ ] Independent agent review posted as a comment, findings answered
- [ ] Review checklist gone through by the person merging

## Labels

- `senior-review` — touches migrations, `can()`, RLS, audit, auth, sync
- `ai-ok` — safe for an agent to pick up without pairing
